__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md and the opnsense/core 26.7.3 source it cites, never by recording a response from an OPNsense firewall. If the survey is wrong about a field, an envelope or a status code, the tests that read this file pass and the collection is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence.
__provenance__.survey_section: Resolver cache and local data, read from source for the resolver-cache cycle
__provenance__.field_list_from: {status, data: [{name, ttl, type, rrtype, value}]} as Unbound/Api/DiagnosticsController.php listlocaldataAction returns scripts/unbound/wrapper.py -d at opnsense/core 26.7.3: the owner is `name` here, ttl the configured TTL, type the CLASS, value the record data's first field.
__provenance__.why_these_values: One host named by an A record, an AAAA record and the two PTR records that map its addresses back, in both IP versions; a TXT record, counted and not stored. The records are a template a test extends with its own, rather than a population.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every name and address below is synthesised for this fixture: the names are under the reserved .test top-level domain (RFC 6761) and the addresses are documentation addresses (RFC 5737, RFC 3849). None of them describes anyone's network, and no code under test presupposes any of them.
